title: The canonical bilinear pairing of the specified inverse image
statement: Let F:Sh(J,Set)→Sh(K,Set) preserve finite limits and let I be the specified AlgebraicInverseImage of R in RI [def-weil-pbc-algebraic-inverse-image]. Transport the actual pure pairing [def-weil-pbc-ringed-tensor-section-calculus] by the finite-product comparison and I.moduleUnderlying. For all R-modules M,N there is an RI-linear map b:I(M) tensor_RI I(N)→I(M tensor_R N) whose values on pure sections equal this transported pairing. For every test sheaf Z and arrows x,y,z with z=pure_R(x,y), b sends pure_RI(Fx,Fy), identified by I.moduleUnderlying.inv, to Fz identified by the same iso. The transported pairing is natural in M,N.

source.place: Tag 03EL, transporting bilinear maps under inverse image

proof.text: Construct pureSheaf as the actual natural pure-tensor map on underlying set sheaves. Transport it using the chosen finite-product monoidal comparison and the supplied module-underlying isomorphisms.

For each additivity or scalar law, take the universal sheaf of its three operands. Product preservation supplies a section above each target triple. Apply I.moduleAdd or I.moduleSMul both to the input operation and to the source bilinear identity. The product projection equations give the four laws. Since the pairing is a sheaf morphism, it commutes with restrictions.

Apply the sheaf tensor bilinear universal property. The monoidal lift comparison proves the formula for every generalized pair. Naturality of the underlying iso, the product comparison, and pureSheaf proves naturality of the transported pairing.

lean.statement:
theorem exists_inverseImageTensorPairing
    (R : Sheaf J CommRingCat.{u}) (RI : Sheaf K CommRingCat.{u})
    (F : Sheaf J (Type u) ⥤ Sheaf K (Type u)) [PreservesFiniteLimits F]
    (I : AlgebraicInverseImage F R RI)
    (M N : SheafOfModules.{u} (ringSheaf R)) :
    ∃ b : (monoidalCategory RI).tensorObj (I.modules.obj M) (I.modules.obj N) ⟶
        I.modules.obj ((monoidalCategory R).tensorObj M N),
      (∀ W m n, b.val.app W (pure RI _ _ W m n) =
        (inverseImagePurePairing R RI F I M N).hom.app W (m, n)) ∧
      ∀ (Z : Sheaf J (Type u)) (x : Z ⟶ (underlying R).obj M)
        (y : Z ⟶ (underlying R).obj N)
        (z : Z ⟶ (underlying R).obj ((monoidalCategory R).tensorObj M N)),
        (∀ W t, z.hom.app W t = pure R M N W (x.hom.app W t) (y.hom.app W t)) →
        ∀ W t, b.val.app W
          (pure RI _ _ W ((F.map x ≫ I.moduleUnderlying.inv.app M).hom.app W t)
            ((F.map y ≫ I.moduleUnderlying.inv.app N).hom.app W t)) =
          (F.map z ≫ I.moduleUnderlying.inv.app
            ((monoidalCategory R).tensorObj M N)).hom.app W t
